Name: Tool Upgrade Reminder
Author: Wracketeer
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Farmers have a lot to do in the morning! So much so that it's easy to forget you left your pickaxe with Clint to be upgraded. Stardew Valley only reminds you that your upgrade is ready once, immediately as you wake up on the day it's ready. With this mod, the message will appear every time you move between locations, or enter/exit buildings, so you'll be consistently reminded to collect your tool.

[size=4][b]Install
[/b][/size]1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
﻿2. Place the ToolUpgradeReminder folder in your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

[size=4][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]Tested and confirmed to work with Stardew Valley 1.5 and 1.6 on Windows. Other platforms/versions have not been tested, but this is presumed to work with all versions. Please let me know if there are any incompatibility issues.

Manifest.Name: Tool Upgrade Reminder
Manifest.Description: Shows the HUD notification for tool upgrades every time you enter a new location.
